facts.fact: The Fieldwork Africa Madagascar market research page was published on 2025-07-23.
Fieldwork Africa states it is a network of field experts across 54 countries in Africa.
facts.quote: We are a Network of Field experts across 54 countries in Africa.

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa's page lists 54 countries it covers under a 'Local expertise, global standards' heading.
Fieldwork Africa says its Madagascar teams are coordinated from Antananarivo and cover Toamasina, Fianarantsoa, Mahajanga, Antsiranana, and all regions.
facts.quote: Our teams operate across Madagascar’s regions, coordinated from Antananarivo, covering Toamasina, Fianarantsoa, Mahajanga, Antsiranana, and all regions.

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa says it offers data collection through CATI, CAPI, CAWI, and face-to-face research methods.
facts.quote: With extensive experience in CATI, CAPI, CAWI, and face-to-face research, we design and execute opinion polls and surveys

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa implemented a large-scale household survey in Madagascar in 2021 on public opinion about governance, service delivery, and community development needs.
facts.quote: Fieldwork Africa implemented a large scale household survey in Madagascar in 2021 to assess public opinion on governance, service delivery, and community development needs.

facts.fact: The Fieldwork Africa Madagascar household survey covered all 23 regions of the country.
facts.quote: The project spanned all 23 regions of the country, with a sample of 9,200 respondents

facts.fact: The Fieldwork Africa Madagascar household survey had a sample of 9,200 respondents.
facts.quote: with a sample of 9,200 respondents gathered through face-to-face interviews (CAPI) and mobile-based data collection tools

facts.fact: The Fieldwork Africa Madagascar survey collected data through face-to-face interviews (CAPI) and mobile-based data collection tools.
facts.quote: gathered through face-to-face interviews (CAPI) and mobile-based data collection tools

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa lists CAPI among its research services.
Fieldwork Africa lists offices in Ghana, Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Gabon, Chad, and Cameroon.
